title: You're Entitled To Nothing
html:
This quote from the legendary Nick Saban will stand the test of time:

"You get up every day—you're entitled to nothing. Nobody owes you nothing. You could have talent, but if you don't have discipline and don't execute, you don't focus… What do you get? Nothing. If you're complacent and not paying attention to detail… What does that get you? Nothing. So nothing is acceptable but your best."

Here's the truth:

You woke up today entitled to nothing.

Not success.

Not praise.

Not even another chance.

You might be talented.

You might even have a head start.

But if you don't show up withdiscipline, if you don't execute withfocus, if you start believing your own hype… You'll get exactly what you earned.

Nothing.

Complacency or Comfort is a silent killer.

It makes you think good enough is good enough.

It tricks you into coasting.

It whispers, "You've done enough.".

Don't listen.

Details matter.

Effort matters.

Yourbest is the bare minimum.

So this week, no coasting. No excuses. Bring the intensity. Bring the focus. Bring the version of you that's impossible to ignore.

Becausenothing is acceptable but your best.
